claims.text: The lane IS the predicate's return value -- no re-derivation, no second table, nothing to drift.
claims.why: The code sets lane=lane_for_host(host) directly from the function's return value, with no further transformation or re-derivation within this chunk.

claims.text: Field names on :class:`VendorReply` -- for the no-verdict-field test.

observations.what: The local vendor availability check catches all exceptions and marks the vendor unavailable with reason 'connect_failed'.
The lane field is directly assigned from lane_for_host(host); the comment emphasizes single-source-of-truth.
The final return statement returns the tuple out, which is built in earlier parts of the function.
reply_field_names derives the field set directly from the VendorReply dataclass, so any change to the dataclass is automatically reflected.
